set.body:
Review basis: commit 8641770. Address all confirmed findings before Frame extraction gate re-closes.

Semantic correctness:
- M2 preserve NullPlacement independently of sort direction and test all four direction/null combinations.
- M7 make filter normalization observationally error-preserving; never evaluate a fallible later predicate on rows rejected by the earlier filter; derive correct boolean nullability.
- M8 make Min and Max both follow the documented NaN-propagation policy independent of input order.

Resource lifetime:
- M3 expose Resource factories for every owning FrameSource; manual close may remain only as the low-level finalizer.
- M5 bracket batch acquisition itself, make slice plus retained registration uncancelable, and make Arrow allocator/root/reader/writer acquisition and reverse cleanup safe on constructor, decode, encode, close, error, and cancellation paths.

Boundary discipline:
- M1 typed using joins must use a total internal constructor rather than throw IllegalStateException.
- M4 catch only NonFatal and preserve non-null diagnostic detail; cleanup failures must not prevent later resources closing.
- M6 preserve Int32Array slice precision so DictionaryArray has no runtime type recovery or impossible string error.
- Add a dedicated non-values-source FrameError instead of stuffing InvalidSourceId.
- Remove unreachable arithmetic/boolean sentinels where a closed operator subset or typed error can express the invariant.

Acceptance:
- JVM and Scala.js regression tests for semantics and cancellation ownership.
- JVM Arrow failure-path and allocator ownership tests.
- warning-clean focused tests, compileAll, testAll, and standalone frame4s extraction rehearsal.
- fresh type-discipline sweep shows no public throw, catch Throwable, runtime recovery of provable array types, or undocumented sentinel in Frame production code.
set.title: Frame remediation: restore semantic, resource, and type-discipline laws
